change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn and its full text and PDF replaced by a withdrawal statement. The withdrawal is because the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, and the reported results cannot be relied on. This includes the stored paper's headline finding of a 2.1 °C lower mean daily peak indoor temperature in green-roofed flats.
evaluation: Your Methods section cites Okafor et al. [14] as the source of the 2.1 °C reduction in daily peak indoor temperature, and sets your model's green-roof effect to 2.1 °C. Your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with the 2.1 °C that you take from Okafor et al. [14]. The stored paper reports that 2.1 °C lower mean daily peak indoor temperature in green-roofed flats. The paper has been withdrawn and its text replaced by a withdrawal statement, which says the indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on. Both uses are touched, and the impact on your draft is high because your key model parameter comes from the withdrawn paper.
recommendation: The paper has been withdrawn and its full text replaced by a withdrawal statement. The notice says the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on. Your draft sets the green-roof effect in its model to 2.1 °C, taking it from Okafor et al. [14]. Your Discussion says its green-roof result scales almost directly with that 2.1 °C. Raise this with your co-authors or supervisor before changing the text, find a reliable replacement value, re-run the model, and then replace or remove citation [14].
